benchmarks.label: Q1 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). date_histogram (monthly) on naive_invoices, created_at < cutoff. No tier breakdown — tier_id absent from invoice docs.
Q2 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). 4 round trips: get(invoice) → get(user) → search(lines) → mget(products). Invoice pool pre-filtered to created_at < cutoff.
Q3 naive at 10% row-based scale (10% of session user_ids). No date cutoff — sessions generated in 2025. search(naive_sessions, user_id, sort=last_active_at).
Q4 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). 3-step orchestration: terms agg(order_items) → ids+status+date filter(orders, created_at < cutoff) → terms agg(order_items, exclude product X).
Q5 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). multi_match on name/description/product_type, default BM25. is_active=True + created_at < cutoff filters.

Q6 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). range(occurred_at) + term(user_id) on naive_events. Anchor pool pre-filtered to occurred_at < cutoff. 30-day window centred on anchor — guaranteed non-empty.

Q7 naive at 10% scale (cutoff 2024-03-20). Full PostgreSQL-equivalent Q7 on [data_min, cutoff]: PIT scans + client-side tier attribution, per-tier daily revenue, gap-fill, rolling 7-day avg. Data min: 2024-01-08.
